notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - July 10/20
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

Some different news today! Since February 2019, we've been sharing a Dev Update, every single week. 

After over [b]70 updates[/b], we realize that this probably isn't the best way to[b] "show"[/b] you what we're working on. Not going to lie, sometimes it looked more like a shopping list instead of exciting features. 

So, we want to bring you a more visual, impactful way to see new features. We're players too, so we want to bring something that's a bit more "wow", and save the features that we're not [i]quite[/i] ready to share yet, and hope they will surprise you. 🙂

This is why we've decided to [b]stop the Weekly Dev Updates[/b] as they are now, which don't exactly reflect what we're working on.

We'll always stay in touch, and keep you updated, with the new concept we'll share here soon!

See you soon,

notes.title: Big News: Tribes of Midgard has a Publisher!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,
 
We’re excited to announce today that...
 
[h3] [b]Norsfell and Gearbox Publishing have teamed up to bring Tribes of Midgard to PlayStation 5! [/b][/h3]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T9REePDIKog

 
[b]Tribes of Midgard will be available in 2021! [/b]We can’t contain our excitement, and are so happy to share this news with you.
 
Nearly two years have passed since we first started working on the game — we’ve received so much feedback and support from all of you during that time, and have seen the game evolve before our eyes. This couldn’t have been possible [b]without such a supportive and enthusiastic community like you[/b], and for that, our thanks are immeasurable.
 
[b]What to Expect[/b]

 
We’re the same team of Vikings, and we’ll still be keeping things as usual around here! We’re just adding additional resources to ensure this game continues to match our vision of what it can become. Posts like our regular dev updates, sneak peeks at upcoming features, and all the love that we share as a community will still continue.
 
If you’re feeling the same excitement as us, feel free to share the trailer!
 
Lastly, from all of us here at Norsfell, thank you/Þakkr! 💙

notes.title: Introducing the Midguardians!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings!

Today, we have some big news to share with you, about game test phases and the Midguardians.

A year ago, we launched our first Closed Alpha, and had 250 Discord members. That was the first time you were able to try Tribes of Midgard (who remembers the flying trees)?

Today, after 3 Closed Alpha and 3 Open Betas, thousands of you are helping us spread Tribes of Midgard across all social networks. This support allows us to gain an incomparable strength helping us to develop Tribes of Midgard. Thank you again, because you really make a huge difference.

There is still a long way to go and we understand and share your excitement around Tribes of Midgard. We would like to be able to leave the gates open at all times, but being still in development, it is difficult for us to do so.

It’s for this reason that we announced that our last Open Beta would be in December 2019. But today, we want to share with you what's coming!

[h1]Introducing: The Midguardians![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/fec714b2bc875701be33e8e56809a5d6d28b8cc0.png[/img]

Next, are private testing phases, reserved for our most active members and framed in a brand new program: The Midguardians!

[b]What are the Midguardians?
[/b]
The Midguardians as we know them today are going to be radically different. A Midguardian is a player who wants to get more involved in the Tribes of Midgard community.

Today, there are 620 Midguardians on our Discord, helping us share Tribes across social networks and getting involved in our Discord. So naturally, we want to reward them, because these small actions add up, and help give us the strength necessary to develop Tribes of MIdgard.
[b]
What are the Rewards?[/b]

Rewards include access to private testing phases, and rewards such as in-game cosmetics, swag, and other surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/b99df13b925b1b1e54a01364eed4a71327fd152c.png[/img]

[b]How to collect these rewards?[/b]

We have implemented a Level and Points system to make the experience more visible and “fair” for everyone. By being active, you increase levels that allow you to access new rewards.

[b]How to join the Midguardians?[/b]

Everything is free and accessible to everyone! However, we ask to apply via a form in order to have you sign an NDA.

[url=https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/852ff989876a79bb73a4ba12f3ac77bc333c4b41.png[/img][/url]


[b]Why an NDA?[/b]

Unlike our first 6 test phases, it will not be possible to stream or create content during these private tests, and you must sign an NDA to take part. We want to use these private tests for feedback with which to keep improving the game.

[h1]What if I'm already a Midguardian?[/h1]

620 people in our Discord joined the first version of the Midguardians. Since it’s now necessary to apply and sign an NDA, we've renamed them, "Midguardians Volunteer". We invite you to apply to become a full Midguardian. It goes without saying that, given your pre-engagement, you will be more likely to be a full Midguardian. Right now, we cannot accept everyone, and plan to have 600 Midguardians at this time to give us time to put everything in place.
[b]
No more Closed Beta/Open Beta?[/b]

We know that we want to offer new testing phases to our community, but at the moment, as we develop the game it is not possible. The Midguardians are a way for us to offer private tests to you, while also allowing us the time to keep working on the game.


We’ll be available on Discord to be answering any and all of your questions, please join here!:

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/7c2338a68ee929a458cc0955528ad76c8418a7cf.png[/img][/url]

We hope you’re excited for this as we are! Thank you for your support! ⚔️🙏

The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Open Beta 3 News
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings!

It's been a little while since our last Open Beta ended, and we're coming at you today with an update on how development's coming along! 👋 As you probably saw, we received a ton of helpful and thoughtful feedback from all of you during the past Beta, and we can't thank you enough for that.

Though, in order to polish the new features we're adding, we've made the decision to move [b]Open Beta 3 to early December[/b]. ❄️

We hope you can understand why we're pushing the date back- it means [b]more time to work on those features[/b] that were suggested, and to make the game [b]as stable as possible[/b] for you all, some of our top priorities. We know how excited you are to play, and are grateful to have you by our side.

This will also be our LAST Open Beta before the game heads into Early Access. So, we're working our hardest to make it a memorable one!

[b]And an update on some new features:[/b]

Next week, we'll start sharing all the new features we're working on for Open Beta 3! Most of them were suggested by you [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]on our Discord[/url], while streaming, and through the Steam forums here.

🌎 Adding new languages into the game 
👋 Wild NPC merchants to discover in the world

🏕️ Creating new Camps in the Land of Pools

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/0a07e84255f1484625f58800b6a2157835f846fb.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/0a07e84255f1484625f58800b6a2157835f846fb.gif[/img][/url]

The Norsfell Team ❄️
